why: The frozen 55-item admission gold is technical noun phrases from ONE self-referential corpus. It contains no pronoun, no wh-word, no sentence-initial quantifier, no clause. Two real documents (a spoken transcript and an academic psychology text) produced ~69% false identity admissions. Negatives and positives are paired FROM THE SAME DOCUMENTS so a passing rule cannot simply be rejecting conversational or academic prose wholesale.
